name: Trance
blurb: Wide, detuned saws over a bass that never stops rolling.

sounds.name: Supersaw lead
sounds.why: Many saws a little out of tune with each other, spread across the stereo field and washed in reverb. The detune is what makes it sound huge.

ingredients.name: One sawtooth
ingredients.adds: The raw material: a bright, buzzy wave.

ingredients.name: Stack the voices
ingredients.adds: Several saws play each note at once.
ingredients.listenFor: It thickens. How much depends on the next two steps.

knobs.label: voices
knobs.below: Thin; you can pick out single voices.
knobs.above: Blurrier and heavier on the CPU for little gain.

ingredients.name: Detune them
ingredients.adds: Each voice drifts slightly off pitch.
ingredients.listenFor: The slow shimmer as the voices beat against each other. This is the trance sound.

knobs.below: The voices line up and it is one saw again.
knobs.above: It reads as out of tune rather than wide.

ingredients.name: Spread them wide
ingredients.adds: Voices are panned left to right.
ingredients.listenFor: The sound moves out of the middle and wraps around you.

knobs.above: The middle goes hollow on a mono speaker.

ingredients.name: Take the edge off
ingredients.adds: Rolls off the fizz at the very top.

knobs.label: cutoff
knobs.above: A fizzy top that fights the hats.

ingredients.name: A big room
ingredients.adds: A long tail that fills the gaps between notes.
ingredients.listenFor: Notes keep ringing after they stop.

knobs.label: reverb
knobs.below: Dry and close, like a demo.
knobs.above: The melody dissolves.

knobs.label: room size
knobs.below: A small box, not a hall.
knobs.above: The tail runs over the next chord.

ingredients.name: Dotted delay
ingredients.adds: Echoes that land between the beats.
ingredients.listenFor: A second, quieter melody answering the first.

knobs.above: The echo is as loud as the note.

knobs.label: feedback
knobs.above: Echoes pile up into the next chord.

pitfalls: Detune past the sweet spot sounds wide alone and sour over the bass.
Reverb and delay both at full hide the melody.

sounds.name: Pluck
sounds.why: The same supersaw, but the filter snaps shut a moment after each note. Short notes plus a dotted delay make one line sound like three.
sounds.pattern: note("a3 c4 e4 a4 e4 c4 a3 e4").fast(2)

ingredients.name: Supersaw
ingredients.adds: The lead's raw tone, held for the full step.

ingredients.name: Short notes
ingredients.adds: Each note dies away quickly.
ingredients.listenFor: Gaps open up between the notes.

knobs.above: Notes smear together; it is a pad again.

ingredients.name: Filter snap
ingredients.adds: Bright at the start of the note, dark by the end.
ingredients.listenFor: A "tik" on the front of every note.

knobs.label: cutoff
knobs.above: No snap: it starts bright and stays bright.

knobs.label: env depth
knobs.above: Harsh and clicky.

knobs.label: env decay
knobs.above: The snap turns into a slow sweep.

ingredients.name: A little resonance
ingredients.adds: A ping at the cutoff as it closes.

knobs.label: resonance
knobs.above: It whistles on every note.

ingredients.name: Dotted delay
ingredients.adds: Echoes fill the gaps the short notes left.
ingredients.listenFor: The pattern seems to double in speed.

knobs.above: You can't tell notes from echoes.

pitfalls: Long decay and long delay together turn the arp to mush.

sounds.why: Punchy and alone on the beat: the rolling bass leaves it its own slot.
Dead straight and bright. Trance hats do not swing: the open hat on the offbeat is the engine of the track.

sounds.name: Rolling bass
sounds.why: The bass plays the three sixteenths between the kicks and never the one under the kick. Kick and bass take turns, so both can be loud.

ingredients.name: One sawtooth
ingredients.adds: A bass note on every sixteenth.

ingredients.name: Leave the kick's slot empty
ingredients.adds: Drops the first sixteenth of every beat.
ingredients.listenFor: With In context on: the kick is suddenly clear and the bass gallops.

ingredients.name: Keep it low
ingredients.adds: Leaves the top of the mix for the lead.

knobs.label: cutoff
knobs.below: Felt, not heard; gone on small speakers.
knobs.above: It buzzes over the pluck.

ingredients.name: Short notes
ingredients.adds: Each note stops before the next begins.

knobs.above: The notes join up and the roll is lost.

ingredients.name: Duck under the kick
ingredients.adds: The backing kick turns the bass down for a moment each time it hits.
ingredients.listenFor: Only with In context on: the bass pumps in time with the kick.

knobs.label: duck depth
knobs.below: No pump; kick and bass blur.
knobs.above: The bass drops out completely on every beat.

pitfalls: A bass note under the kick makes both sound smaller.

sounds.name: Offbeat bass
sounds.why: The older, simpler trance bass: one note between every pair of kicks. Kick, bass, kick, bass, like a pendulum.

ingredients.name: One sawtooth
ingredients.adds: A bass note twice a beat, on the kick and between.

ingredients.name: Only the offbeat
ingredients.adds: Drops the note that lands on the kick.
ingredients.listenFor: With In context on: kick and bass take turns.

ingredients.name: Keep it low
ingredients.adds: Leaves the top of the mix for the lead.

knobs.label: cutoff
knobs.above: It buzzes over the lead.

ingredients.name: Short notes
ingredients.adds: Each note stops well before the next kick.

knobs.above: The notes join up.

ingredients.name: Jump an octave
ingredients.adds: The third note of each bar is an octave up.
ingredients.listenFor: A small hook appears in the bassline.

sounds.name: Gated pad
sounds.why: A held chord chopped into a sixteenth-note rhythm, so harmony and groove come from one part.

ingredients.name: A held chord
ingredients.adds: One long chord per bar.

ingredients.name: Darken it
ingredients.adds: Pushes the pad behind the lead.

knobs.label: cutoff
knobs.above: It competes with the lead.

ingredients.name: The gate
ingredients.code: .struct("x x ~ x x ~ x x x ~ x x ~ x x ~").clip({clip})
ingredients.adds: Chops the chord into a rhythm.
ingredients.listenFor: The chord starts to stutter in time.

knobs.label: gate length
knobs.above: The gaps close and the rhythm goes.

ingredients.name: Open it over 8 bars
ingredients.adds: The filter rises and falls on its own.
ingredients.listenFor: The pad slowly brightens toward the drop.

knobs.label: sweep top
knobs.below: Too small a change to notice.
knobs.above: Harsh at the peak.

ingredients.name: Room
ingredients.adds: Softens the hard edges of the gate.

knobs.label: reverb
knobs.above: The tail fills the gaps you just cut.

sounds.name: Acid line (breakdown)
sounds.why: The acid house sound, tuned brighter and more resonant so it cuts through the reverb in a breakdown.
Eight bars of noise getting brighter and louder. It tells the room the drop is coming.
The crash and boom on the first beat after the breakdown, when the kick comes back.
